defs.def: a thin flat piece of food that has been cut off a larger piece （切下的食物）薄片，片

ex.s: Handing out sliced oranges to bloodthirsty kids can be as exciting as watching your own kid score a goal.
ex.t: 给那些“嗜血”的孩子们分发橙子片，可能和看自家孩子进球一样令人兴奋。

ex.s: Later, I learnt that the most famous food in Shandong is pancake rolls stuffed with sliced Chinese green onions.
ex.t: 后来，我了解到山东最有名的食物是煎饼卷大葱。

ex.s: If you have a juicer, you can simply feed in frozen bananas and some berries or sliced fruit.
ex.t: 如果你有一个果汁机,你可以简单地在冰冻的香蕉和一些浆果或切片的水果中觅食.

ex.s: If you eat two slices, you eat two sixths or one third.
ex.t: 若食二片,则食六分之二或三分之一.

ex.s: Jenna threw the burnt piece into the sink and put in the other slice of bread.
ex.t: 詹娜把烤焦的那片扔进   水池，又放进去另一片面包。

ex.s: Jenna threw the burnt piece into the  sink and put in the other slice of bread.
ex.t: 詹娜把烤焦的那片扔进   水池，又放进去另一片面包。

ex.s: Jenna found the bread and put two slices into the egg mixture.
ex.t: 珍娜找到了面包，把两片放进鸡蛋混合物里。

ex.s: When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 当与浆果或其他水果切片结合时,冰冻的香蕉为厚、冷却的水果摇摆和低脂“冰淇淋”提供了极佳的基础。

ex.s: Slices of garlic can be used to create teeth.
ex.t: 大蒜的切片可以用来制造牙齿.

ex.s: Served plain in thin, white slices, the meat is juicy and salty.
ex.t: 服务平原为薄,白色切片,肉质多汁,咸.

defs.def: a part or share of sth 部分；份额
a kitchen utensil (= tool) that you use to lift and serve pieces of food 锅铲；（餐桌用）小铲
a stroke that makes the ball spin to one side rather than going straight ahead 高尔夫球、网球等
to cut sth into slices 把 … 切成（薄）片
to cut sth easily with or as if with a sharp blade 切；割；划
to hit a ball so that it spins and does not move in the expected direction 削（球）；斜切打
to hit the ball so that it flies away in a curve, when you do not mean to 高尔夫球
to reduce sth by a large amount 大幅度削减；大量降低
